{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=May 2025}} {{Infobox football match | title = 1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Final | image = 1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final.jpg | image_size = 250 | event = [[1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]] | team2 = [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] | team2association = [[File:Limerick colours.PNG|40px]] | team2score = 1–13 | team1 = [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] | team1association = [[File:Kilkenny colours.PNG|40px]] | team1score = 3–19 | details = | date = 1 September 1974 | stadium = [[Croke Park]] | city = Dublin | man_of_the_match1a = | referee = [[John Moloney (referee)|John Moloney]] ([[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]]){{cite book |title=The Complete Handbook of Gaelic Games |date=2021 |publisher=DBA Publications Ltd. |location=Dublin |page=28 |url=https://www.gaa.ie/api/images/image/upload/t_q-best/t8bphnbixyanijooj1un.pdf |access-date=5 December 2024}} | attendance = 62,071 | weather = | previous = [[1973 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|1973]] | next = [[1975 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|1975]] }} The '''1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final''' was the 87th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the [[1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], an inter-county [[hurling]] tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at [[Croke Park]], Dublin, on 1 September 1974, between [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] and [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]]. The Munster champions lost to their Leinster opponents on a score line of 3–19 to 1–13.{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.gaa.ie/videos/1974-all-ireland-senior-hurling-championship-final |title=1974 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final |date=2024-01-25 |type=Video |language=en |access-date=2024-12-04 |via=Gaa.ie}}{{Cite web |last=Byrne |first=Stephen |date=2020-12-10 |title=Facts & Figures: Here's what you need to know ahead of the All Ireland Senior Hurling Final |url=https://scoreline.ie/facts-figures-heres-what-you-need-to-know-ahead-of-the-all-ireland-senior-hurling-final/ |access-date=2024-12-04 |website=Scoreline.ie |language=en-GB}} {{TOC left}} {{Clear}} ==Match details== {{football box | date = 1974-09-01
